nodes.label: The Tantalum Test (Screening Bracket at Ta, Pd, Au)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: All engineerable conditions C1-C4 are set to their best values so that the outcome, whatever it is, is a statement about C0 alone — whether beam screening is also shown to a thermal bound deuteron. Verdicts are inherited from the protocol unchanged.

nodes.label: C0 — beam screening versus thermal bound screening
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Ta's U_e = 309 +- 12 eV is verified and independently confirmed, and no ambient-null archive exists for it, so a one-day null already yields U_e,amb < 117 eV — a translation deficit of at least 3x in potential and 1e13 in rate, and the first ambient number tantalum will ever have.

nodes.label: The cooldown as a self-contained verdict
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Under the verified Debye T-dependence any genuine C0 effect must grow on cooling and not gently — at a room-temperature coordinate of 4.5 the 77 K rate is ~1e8 times larger — so signal detonates or the classical map is dead at that coordinate. An effect that shrinks or holds flat is not this effect.

nodes.label: Sensitivity ladder — the first day decides
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: The exponential makes the coordinate bound nearly exposure-independent (U_e,amb ceiling moves only 117 -> 110 eV from 1 day to 90 days), so long exposure buys precision on the ceiling rather than reach.

nodes.label: E1 angular character as a selection-rule refusal
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Low-energy p+d capture is E1 with an ideal N(90)/N(30) of 4.0, so a candidate line failing the ratio is refused rather than argued about; the angular form is flagged as recalled and must be pinned to measured p-d capture data before Run 0.

nodes.label: Materials matrix as the periodic table's own null row
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Ta and Pd as large-effect metals against Au (verified no-effect) and an insulator coupon: the on/off pattern across four materials and three fills is a signature no mundane artefact reproduces, which is why the blanks are materials rather than only empty runs.
